description:
We are a team from Tajikistan passionate about technology, Earth science, and turning complex data into useful products.

Our skills include iOS development (Swift, SwiftUI, MapKit), GIS, spatial data analysis, and data visualization.

We enjoy building real-world solutions using NASA open data.

We're looking for motivated teammates with experience in Python, data science, meteorology, remote sensing, GIS, or UI/UX design who want to create something impactful together!
